title: Verdict v0: one criteria path's answer for one scene
description: Per criterion pass / fail / unsure with reason, measured value, margin vs threshold, uncertainty and the views still needed. Contract: docs/scene-and-verdict-format.md. Lengths in feet (suffix _ft) because every threshold is written in feet; locations along the wall chain use the scene's s in meters (suffix _m) so they point back into the scene without conversion.

path.description: Track C path id, e.g. C1-rules-hs11, C2-volumetric, C3-vlm-judge.

rules_profile.description: public, A, B, C or strictest.

decision.description: Placement decision for the site. needs-more-photos is expressed by manual_review plus a non-empty views_needed.

candidates.description: Battery positions the evaluator considered. Runs of equal outcome along a wall may be one candidate with a start range.

start_s_m.description: Range of the battery's left-edge position s (a single start has start = end).

views_needed.description: Views that would settle an UNSURE caused by unobserved space or an unread attribute. Empty for pass and reject. This list is the fog-of-war contract back to the iOS team.

target.description: What to photograph, e.g. 'meter label close-up', 'ground 4.3 m out from the wall'.

id.description: Criterion id from the catalogue in docs/scene-and-verdict-format.md, e.g. opening_clearance, meter_identity.

unsure_cause.description: Only for unsure. margin: measured inside the error band. unobserved: the deciding space was not seen (more photos fix it). unknown_attribute: a fact the photos did not establish. rule_requires_review: the policy sends it to a person. generated_only: the only geometry there is generated. not_evaluated: the path cannot evaluate this criterion.

plus_minus_ft.description: Uncertainty bound: the true value lies within this distance.

subject.description: What was measured to, e.g. 'objects[win-5] window'.

fact.description: Non-metric finding of a photo or close-up prompt (meter number, CL320, meter type, P12 flag). clean=false means the evidence was insufficient; such a criterion is never pass.

raw.description: The prompt's own output value, e.g. yes / no / manual_review, cl320_unclear.

review_value_ft.description: Review band line (e.g. confident reach 15 ft under a 20 ft max).

margin_ft.description: Signed distance from the measured value to the threshold, positive on the passing side.

margin_over_uncertainty.description: margin_ft / plus_minus_ft. PASS needs > 1 (C5 margin rule), FAIL needs < -1.
